run_blaser_training: run the BLASER model training pipeline with a BlaserTrainConfig to train and save the model
run_train_iterations: run training iterations on a PyTorch model with train and validation datasets using AdamW optimizer
create_blaser_train_config: create a BlaserTrainConfig dataclass to configure BLASER training with hyperparameters like learning rate and epochs
create_data_config: create a DataConfig dataclass to specify source, reference, MT embedding files and label file paths
run_main_hydra: run the Hydra-configured main entry point to start BLASER training from command line with config files
